prompt: A diagonal of a polygon joins two corners that are not next to each other. How many diagonals does a regular hexagon (a six-sided shape) have in total?
explanation: From each of the 6 corners you can draw diagonals to 3 corners (every corner except itself and its two neighbours), giving 6 x 3 = 18. Each diagonal has been counted from both ends, so halve it: 9 diagonals.
